reason: Document A is more likely to get me to act. It offers something in return: a list of residents who need help in emergencies and a meeting on any weekday evening. It also admits I may be right about the second elevator, so it reads like reasonable people I can work with rather than a few loud complainers. Document B makes demands, points to the TV coverage as pressure and offers nothing back, which makes it easier for me to wave away. Its 'From: The residents' line slightly overstates who A speaks for, though it is signed on behalf of the association.
